name: Orlistat 60mg — 84 Capsules (Generic for Alli®)
short: Orlistat 60mg — 84 Capsules (Generic for Alli®) — Over-the-counter. Trusted bilingual delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo, 24/7.
description:
Orlistat 60mg — 84 Capsules (Generic for Alli®) is part of a medically supervised weight-management program for adult patients meeting specific BMI and clinical criteria. Stored at controlled temperature at our Cabo facility and delivered with cold-chain integrity where required.

Typical use involves a titration schedule determined by the prescribing physician, combined with dietary and lifestyle adjustments. Inform your healthcare provider of any history of pancreatic, thyroid, or gastrointestinal disorders before starting therapy.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Refrigerated delivery available within the Los Cabos corridor.
